resources.string: Keeping chats and calls connected in the background
A remote session you accepted is active. Open Lumora to end it.
Lumora keeps your call going while the app is in the background.
A remote session you accepted is waiting to see your screen. Tap to open Lumora and allow it.

Lets a person you approved in Lumora tap, swipe and type on this phone during a remote-support session. Lumora only acts while a session you accepted is active, and never reads or stores what is on your screen.

Android only lets apps perform taps and typing for you through an Accessibility service. Turn on “Lumora – Remote control” so the person you are connected with can operate this phone. Screen viewing works without it.
Open “Installed apps” (or “Downloaded apps”) and choose “Lumora – Remote control”.
Switch it on and confirm with “Allow”.
Come back to Lumora – this screen closes by itself.
If the switch is greyed out (“Restricted setting”, Android 13+ for apps not installed from a store): open App info → ⋮ menu → “Allow restricted settings”, then try again.
Privacy: input is only accepted from the viewer of a session you approved, over an end-to-end encrypted connection. You can turn the service off at any time.
